name: RAR sales_agent
description: A sales agent may act only in regions its attestation names. A request is permitted when every requested region is one the attestation names, compared as whole regions, and a principal stands behind it: a person (authenticated, or from a subject token) or the client itself. A client alone (no person) that asks for EMEA among them is narrowed to EMEA. Anything else - a region the attestation does not name, a part of one, an empty list, or a principal from an identity hint or none - is denied.

rules.name: narrow a client-only request to EMEA
rules.description: No person stands behind a client-credentials request, so it is held to the home region.

rules.name: permit the attested regions
rules.description: Every requested region is one the attestation names: the space-joined request matches att_sales_regions_pattern, which accepts only a list of whole attested regions. An identity hint or no principal is not enough.
